issues.subject: aoao
issues.fact: Intact contact insert had a false missing rim; later poses restored its outline.
issues.impact: Breaks perceived continuity, character identity or physical staging.
issues.hypothesis: An unreviewed shared polygon cut through the intact drawing; old insert silhouette also differed.
issues.next_action: Retain comparison and recheck this relation whenever pose or asset source changes.
issues.change: Replace both contact/detail inserts with one complete round-rim right-arm cel and persist shared crack coordinates.
issues.result: Round lower rim remains complete in intact and cracked inserts, and full poses no longer have to inherit a false missing chunk.

iterations.benefit: Common prop silhouette/right arm, explicit shield lowering, painted furnace interior, single expression cels, slimmer exit.
iterations.remaining: Finite pose naturalness and normal-speed audiovisual review.

misses.previous_judgment: R5 recorded component carry, portrait stability and exit camera scale as fixed in sampled scope. Original report remains unchanged.
misses.later_evidence: Six user screenshots reveal topology, anatomical side, shield orientation, opening interior, intermediate-expression ghosting and body proportions.
misses.change: Trace actual contours and shoulder-elbow-wrist-thumb chain; compare intermediate expressions and same-angle anatomy separately from state labels and camera height.
misses.limits: A broader checklist and source fingerprints do not guarantee artistic continuity.

reviewer_conclusion: Six reported defects have concrete R6 changes and final decoded evidence. Body rise and gait remain visibly stepped; two AV checks need listening evidence. This is not a complete artistic or film-quality acceptance.
